rules.title_vi: Tổ chức đăng ký tại Úc
rules.quote: The applicant must be an entity registered in Australia with an active ABN.
Projects are expected to total a minimum of $200,000 for the grant period.

rules.title_vi: Không nằm trong danh sách cấm
rules.quote: Applicants must not appear on any Commonwealth sanctions or disqualification list.
